tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.15;
father of: Jahzeiah (H3167)
§ Tikvath or Tikvah = "hope"
1) father of Shallum, the husband of the prophetess Huldah in the time of king Josiah of Judah
2) father of Jahaziah (Tikvah) in the time of Ezra

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Tikvah, the name of two Israelites
